description: This file contains utility functions for computing SHA-256 hashes of inline `<script>` blocks within HTML, primarily for Content Security Policy (CSP) purposes. It includes functions to extract inline scripts, compute their hashes, and build CSP header strings.

methods.name: computeInlineScriptHashes
methods.description: Processes an HTML string to find inline `<script>` tags, computes SHA-256 hashes of their content, and returns an array of formatted hash strings for CSP.

methods.name: buildControlUiCspHeader
methods.description: Constructs a Content Security Policy header string, optionally including hashes of inline scripts provided.
